input: hey can you add chicken breast to our weekly grocey delivery? about 3 lb boneless skinless, fresh not frozen, and it needs to come in the sunday 9-11am slot from our usual store here in lincoln park. under $25 for the chicken pls. i want good-quality chicken for the kids, natural with nothing artificial, and no hormones or other junk in it. just pick the best one and add it to the order, thx

experiences.name: Green Acres Broccoli & Baby Carrot Bundle (3 lb)
experiences.description: Fresh broccoli crowns and sweet baby carrots, about 3 lb in total, ready for weeknight sides and lunchbox snacks. Grown in California and packed in recyclable bags. Available for Sunday 9–11am delivery.

experiences.name: Heartland Valley 100% Natural Chicken Breast, Family Pack (3.2 lb)
experiences.description: Labels: 100% Natural • No Added Hormones or Steroids* • Raised by Family Farmers. *Federal regulations prohibit the use of hormones or steroids in poultry. Fresh boneless, skinless chicken breast in a 3.2 lb vacuum-sealed family pack. No artificial ingredients; water-chilled and processed in Arkansas. Certifications: none listed. Available for Sunday 9–11am delivery.
